proposed_temporal_designation.historical_semantics: Historiographical Swedish great-power period, not an officially adopted imperial state-form, sovereign secession, imperial coronation, nor a formal change from Kingdom to Empire.

periodization_alternative.interpretation: Great Northern War and 1721 territorial/peace settlement; scholarly alternate span. Do not silently reconcile with 1611–1718 Lex period convention.

review_sources.author: Jürgen Beyer
review_sources.claim: Traditional Swedish historical period 1611–1718, from Gustav II Adolf accession to Charles XII death; contemporary official empire title is NOT claimed.

review_sources.author: Harald Gustafsson
review_sources.claim: The great-power-age conceptual terminology entered common Swedish historiography in the late 19th century, reinforcing historically retrospective period-name type rather than constitutional state-form.

review_sources.author: Tobias E. Hämmerle
review_sources.claim: Uses a 1611–1721 Swedish great-power era while describing the sovereign as the Swedish Kingdom.
